links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to oral cancer questions (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Bard had the highest Flesch Reading Ease score (62 ± 7); ChatGPT-3.5 and Claude scored lowest, meaning more challenging readability.
links.quote: Bard had the highest Flesch Reading Ease score of 62 ± 7; and ChatGPT-3.5 and Claude received the lowest scores (more challenging readability).

links.outcome: Accuracy of citations in chatbot responses to oral cancer questions
links.effect: Most chatbots did not perform well on citation accuracy; GPT-4 and Bard were best, and Bing showed the lowest citation accuracy.
links.quote: Although impressive in their ability to guide patients on common oral cancer topics, most chatbots did not perform well when assessed for empathy or citation accuracy.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, empathy, readability, and citation accuracy of five commercial LLM chatbots answering frequently asked questions about oral oncology without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
